profile: PENDANT_COOPERATIVE_SAVE with 160000 samples at assumed/required 16000 Hz
bench_method: Integrate storage-rail current over complete consecutive 10-second periods, including wake, data, metadata, sync, close, rename and final CTRL_SYNC; mA*s equals mC.
Separately integrate whole-system battery current; do not infer MCU encryption, microphone or regulator loss from storage-rail current.
Retain waveform sample rate/bandwidth, board/ELF/card revision, battery voltage, temperature and filesystem occupancy.
Capture initial boot/mount/recovery and final commit separately and include their charge in full-session total.
Run selected card through nearly-full and aged/fragmented media as well as empty media; average over complete sessions and inspect peaks.
limits: 110mAh x 70% usable is an assumption; the adopted 4.4mA target does not prove16h at actual voltage cutoff.
Hypothetical active/idle levels are not guaranteed card limits; peak remains independently limited by pack and regulator.
131072 bytes is a firmware safety ceiling, not an observed file size. Effective service rate includes all overhead and is not a card advertised sequential speed.

A 10-second local allocation can be exceeded transiently if measured full-session charge and buffering remain within independently verified limits; this is a design screen, not an invented battery peak rating.
Selected storage candidate remains unqualified; no measured charge, validated usable battery energy or runtime result.

Payload-only comparison assumes the hypothetical active current applies throughout SPI transfer; negative remaining time rejects that scenario, not the actual unmeasured storage part. Metadata, busy and commands add time beyond this lower bound.
